learning_outcomes.text: Have the ability to design suitable parts for casting, design runners and feeders and make calculations under the light of casting design criteria by using modern equipment and basic knowledge
Knows the equipment and auxiliary materials used in casting
Knows the effects of casting methods on human and environmental health
Knows the design and manufacturing of forging dies.

syllabus_topics: Introduction of casting, Classification of casting methods, Models
Mold materials, molding and mold properties
Plaster, Ceramic, Precision mold casting and pressure casting
Plaster, Ceramic, Precision mold casting and pressure casting
Introduction to tattoo technology. Recipes. general informations. Process variables
Forging machines. hydraulic, mechanical, screw presses. Hammers.
